title: Find the full names of members who incurred expenses for events categorized
question: Find the full names of members who incurred expenses for events categorized as 'Meeting', where the expense amount exceeded the overall average expense cost. Only consider expenses linked to budgets with a non-negative remaining balance.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_035, m.XCL_036
FROM member AS m
JOIN expense AS e ON m.XCL_034 = e.XCL_022
JOIN budget AS b ON e.XCL_023 = b.XCL_003
JOIN event AS ev ON b.XCL_009 = ev.XCL_010
WHERE ev.XCL_013 = 'Meeting'
  AND b.XCL_006 >= 0
  AND e.XCL_020 > (SELECT AVG(XCL_020) FROM expense)
